title: Constructive CLM-005 — Scaffold Removal / Endogenous Control

parent_evidence.core_005: replay-free Cell-local subspace certificate reused as fixed safety primitive

question: Can learned routing and learned write/grow control replace the explicit Constructive CLM control scaffolds while preserving protected continual writes, bounded growth, child reuse, sparse compute and unseen simultaneous/sequential multi-Cell composition?

required_for_positive: learned pairwise route compatibility at inference
zero learner-side replay in protected mutation stream
unseen simultaneous and order-sensitive sequential composition after scaffold removal

controller_learning.principle: controllers are trained only on permanently development-only meta episodes; labels are current-transaction intrinsic/counterfactual utility decisions, never hidden factor/task/Cell IDs

router.architecture: shared 5->12->1 pairwise MLP over query/key compatibility statistics
router.label: candidate Cell with lowest current-transaction operator-fit error

growth.label: fresh Cell utility beats best existing Cell utility by registered spawn cost

stages.description: unchanged CLM-004 on the same new seed, evaluator-only baseline
replace fixed cosine argmax route rule with frozen meta-learned pairwise compatibility scorer
learned write controller commits certificate-feasible updates and rejects conflicts; learned growth controller converts rejected useful conflicts into reusable children
evaluate unseen simultaneous/sequential composition over roots plus learned children
a certificate-safe shared residual update must fit current data without changing registered historical full-composition outputs

learner_forbidden_inputs: hidden task/mode label as controller target
evaluator_only: source Cell identity used to generate/evaluate synthetic transactions

seed_discipline.note: 90711/90712/90713 were used only in a partial shared-substrate diagnostic before protocol freeze and are permanently excluded. 90811/90812/90813 are untouched at freeze time.

no_repeat: A positive result closes the controlled Constructive CLM mechanism-validation sequence. Do not create CLM-005B by merely increasing synthetic cells/transactions; move to Small Native CLM v0.
